title: Electronics Maintenance Officer Aviation Command and Control (C2) (II) (LtCol to Capt) PMOS, DC AVN
raw_text:
1. MOS 5902, Electronics Maintenance Officer Aviation Command and Control
(C2) (II) (LtCol to Capt) PMOS, DC AVN

    a. Summary. The Electronics Maintenance Officer Aviation Command and
Control (C2) Officers supervise and coordinate the installation, operation,
and maintenance of all aviation C2 electronic systems and equipment used by
the Marine Air Command and Control Systems (MACCS) units, Littoral Anti-Air
Battalion (LAAB), and Air Traffic Control (ATC) systems at Marine Corps Air
Stations (MCAS). Lead communications planner for the MACCS in expeditionary
amphibious base operations for ensured C2 during littoral operations in a
contested environment. Fleet marine forces billet assignments for this
officer will be in the S-6 at the squadron or group level within the marine
air control group, battalion S-6 at the LAAB and Low Altitude Air Defense
(LAAD). Non-Fleet marine forces billet assignments for the Electronics
Maintenance Aviation C2 Officers include billets at the Marine Corps
Communication-Electronics School, Marine Aviation Training Support Group 23,
Training and Education Command, Marine Corps Tactical Systems Support
Activity, Acquisition Project Officer at Marine Corps Systems Command,
Requirements Officer at Marine Corps Combat Development Command, and
occupational field manager at Headquarters Marine Corps.

       b.   Prerequisites

        (1) Security requirement: top secret or top secret with sensitive
compartmented information eligibility.

        (2) Must meet eligibility and appointment criteria as prescribed in
MCO 1040.42B, WO and LDO accession programs.

        (3) This MOS may only be assigned to officers previously qualified in
one of the following MOSs 5910, Aviation Radar Maintenance Officer, 5950, Air
Traffic Control System Maintenance Officer, or 5970, Tactical Data Systems
Maintenance Officer.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) This MOS is career progression for officers in MOSs 5910, 5950,
and 5970. MOS is assigned after Marine is promoted to captain. All 5902s
are highly encouraged to attend the following courses based on their current
duty assignments and previous career training:

            (a) JT-101 Introduction to Joint Multi-TDL Network (MTN)
Operations (J30 P-US1380).

                (b) Weapons and Tactics Instructor Course (M149731).

                (c) Link 16 Joint Interoperability Course (J3O P-US109).

                (d) Marine Air Traffic Control Maintenance Managers Course
(N23KCN2).

            (e) Multi-Tactical Data Link Advanced Joint Interoperability
Course (A05L6Z1 or A05L6ZM).




                                        1-231                          Enclosure (1)
 1134                                                               NAVMC 1200.1L



            (f) Defense Acquisition University ACQ 1010 Fundamentals of
Systems Acquisition Management via DAU at https://icatalog.dau.edu.

            (g) Defense Acquisition University ACQ 1010 Fundamentals of
Systems Acquisition Management via DAU at https://icatalog.dau.edu.

       d.   Duties

        (1) Collects and analyzes maintenance data to permit system/equipment
performance evaluation.

        (2) Provides information concerning the capabilities, limitations,
and reliability of ground electronic systems and equipment.

        (3) Reviews estimates and justifications for funds required for
the maintenance of aviation command and control electronic systems and
equipment.

        (4) Manages the status of equipment, progress of work, parts
availability, training, qualifications of maintenance personnel, and advises
the commanding officer on all technical matters pertaining to ground
electronic systems and equipment.

        (5) Supervises and coordinates the activities of sections engaged in
the installation, operation, and maintenance of ground electronic systems and
equipment used in the Marine Air Command and Control System and Marine Corps
Air Stations.

       e.   Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code

            (1) Mangers, All Others 11-9199.

        (2) First-Line Supervisors/Managers of Mechanics, Installers, and
Repairers 49-1011.

       f.   Related Military Skill

            (1) Aviation Radar Systems Officer, 5910.

            (2) Air Traffic Control Systems Officer, 5950.

            (3) Tactical Data Systems Officer, 5970.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
